plugins.name: ship-task
plugins.description: Push the current task branch, open a PR, watch checks, squash-merge, sync the default branch and clean up.

plugins.name: codebase-cleanup
plugins.description: Audit a codebase for dead code, duplication and tech debt, verify every finding, then carry the cleanup out as small, reviewable PRs once you approve.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Run a planner-led agent team (PM, lead engineer, engineers, QA) that message each other, with each teammate's model picked by what its task needs.
